verses.en: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verses.sm: Kalatia valea e, o ai ea na ja pelogia outou, o e ua tusia i luma o o outou lava mata o Iesu Keriso ua faasatauroina?

verses.en: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.sm: Ua nao le mea nei ou te fia iloa ia te outou: pe na maua e outou le Agaga i galuega o le tulafono, po o te taulogologo atu i le faatuatua?

verses.en: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
verses.sm: Tou te faapea ea ona valelea? Na amataina outou i le Agaga, pe faaiuina nei ea outou i le tino?

verses.en: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
verses.sm: Pe na oo mai fua ia te outou ia mea e tele lava, pe afai e moni na oo mai fua?

verses.en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.sm: s O le ua avatu ia te outou le Agaga, ma na faia vavega ia te outou, o galuega ea o le tulafono ua ia fai ai, po o le taulogologo atu i le faatuatua?

verses.en: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
verses.sm: Faapei o Aperaamo na faatuatua i le Atua, ona taʻua ai lea ia te ta e fai ma amiotonu.

verses.en: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia Poa e outou, o e faatuatua O atalii i latou o Aperaamo.

verses.en: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
verses.sm: Na iloa foi anamua i le Tusi, o le faatuatua e ta‘uamiotonuina ai nuu ese e le Atua, na ia folafolaina ai anamua le tala lelei ia Aperaamo, ua faapea, E manuia nuu uma lava ta te oe.

verses.en: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua manuia e ua faatuatua faatasi ma Aperaamo le na faatuatua.

verses.en: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
verses.sm: Aua o i latou uma o e faalagolago i galuega o le tulafono, ua faafanoina i latou; aua ua tusia, Ja faafanoina i latou uma o e le tumau i mea uma lava ua tusia i le tusi o le tulafono, ia faia.

verses.en: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
verses.sm: A ua iloa lelei, e le ta‘uamiotonuina se tasi i luma o le Atua i le tulafono; auā, E ola le tagata amiotonu i le faatuatua;

verses.en: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
verses.sm: a e le aiā le faatuatua i le tulafono, aua, O le tagata na te faia ia mea e ola ai lava ía.

verses.en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
verses.sm: Na faatauina mai i tatou e Keriso ai le faafanoga o le tulafono, ina ua faafanoina o ia mo i tatou—aua ua tusia,

verses.en: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.sm: E faafanoina i latou uma o e ua faatautauina i le laau—14 ina ia oo ai i nuu ese le manuia o Aperaamo ia Keriso Iesu, ina ia tatou maua i le faatuatua le na folafolaina, o le Agaga lea.

verses.en: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
verses.sm: Le au uso e, (o upu a tagata ou te fai atu ai nei): e ui lava na o le feagaiga a le tagata, afai ua faamauina, e leai se na te tatalaina, pe na te faapoopoina ai se mea.

verses.en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
verses.sm: Na fetalaia mai folafolaga ia Aperaamo, ma so lana fanau; e lei faapea mai, “O le fanau, peiseai e toatele,” a e toatasi, “O so lau fanau”, o Keriso lava lea.

verses.en: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
verses.sm: la, o laʻu upu lenei: o le feagaiga na faamauina anamua e le Atua, e le mafai ona tatalaina lea e le tulafono na mulimuli ai i ona tausaga e fa selau ma le tolugafulu, ina ia faaleaogaina ai le mea na folafolaina.

verses.en: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
verses.sm: Aua afai ua ala mai le tou i le tulafono, ua le ala mai i le upu na folafolaina; a e peitai, na foaifuaina atu e le Atua ia Aperaamo i le mea na folafolaina.

verses.en: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
verses.sm: O lenei, se a le aoga o le tulafono? Na faaopoopo mai lea ona o solitulafono, ina seia maliu mai le fanau na folafola i ai, sa saunia e agelu na aumaia e le tautuu upu.

verses.en: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
verses.sm: A e leai se tautuu upu pe a na o le toatasi, a e toatasi le Atua.

verses.en: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
verses.sm: Lenei foi, e ‘au ese ea le tulafono i mea na folafolaina e le Atua? Aua neʻi faapea. Aua, afai ana tuuina mai se tulafono e mafai ona faaolaina ai, po ua oo mai lava le amiotonu i le tulafono.

verses.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
verses.sm: A e peitai ua punitia e le Tusi mea uma lava i le agasala, ina ia foaiina mai i e faatuatua le mea na folafolaina e maua i le faatuatua ia Iesu Keriso.

verses.en: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.sm: A o lei 00 mai le faatuatua, na taofia i tatou i le pule a le tulafono, sa punitia ina seia faaalia le faatuatua a oo mai.

verses.en: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua fai mo tatou taʻitaʻitama le tulafono, na te taʻitaʻiina i tatou ia Keriso, ina ia ta‘uamiotonuina i tatou i le faatuatua.

verses.en: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
verses.sm: A ua oo mai le faatuatua, o lenei ua le toe pule ia te i tatou le ta‘ita‘itama;

verses.en: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.sm: aua o atalii o le Atua outou uma lava i le faatuatua ia Keriso Iesu.

verses.en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.sm: Auā o outou uma lava na papatisoina ia Keriso, ua outou oofu ia Keriso;

verses.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.sm: e le o i ai se Iutaia po o se Eleni, e le o i ai se pologa po o se sa‘oloto, e le o i ai se tane po o se fafine; aua ua tasi lava outou uma ia Keriso Iesu.

verses.en: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.sm: Afai foi e o Keriso outou, e moni, o le fanau vutou a Aperaamo, o suli foi e tusa ma le mea na folafolaina.
